request.style: English, male baritone voice with backing choir, electric guitar, bass, drums, organ, dark and hopeful mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The eighth month in the second year
The word of the Lord came near
To Zechariah son of Iddo
He heard the spirit's quiet load
The Lord was furious with your fathers
They did not listen to the prophets
But my words overtook your fathers
They repented in their own disasters

[Pre-Chorus]
Return to me declares the Lord
And I will return to you once more
Do not be like your fathers now
Turn from your evil ways and vow

[Chorus]
The measuring line will be stretched out
Over Jerusalem in this hour
My house will be rebuilt there
The Lord of hosts declares it fair
My cities will overflow with prosperity
The Lord will comfort Zion freely

[Verse]
In the night I had a vision
A man on a red horse's mission
Standing among the myrtle trees
The angel spoke to me with ease
Patrolling the earth at rest and peace
Seventy years of anger cease
The Lord answered with kind words
Comfort for the broken and blurred

[Pre-Chorus]
Jealous for Jerusalem with burning fire
Angry with the nations that are near
I have returned with mercy to the land
My people shall be safe and stand

[Chorus]
The measuring line will be stretched out
Over Jerusalem in this hour
My house will be rebuilt there
The Lord of hosts declares it fair
My cities will overflow with prosperity
The Lord will comfort Zion freely

[Bridge]
Four horns that scattered Judah fell
Four craftsmen came to break them
Joshua stood in filthy clothes
The angel spoke of holy hopes
Take the guilt away from you
Clothe you in fine robes anew
I am going to bring the Branch
A sign for your strength

[Outro]
The plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel
Grace grace to the capstone
The eyes of the Lord range through the earth
He sees the heart of the man
